test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'FINGER' is written as '69147518' and 'DOG' is written '4157'. How will 'FOREST' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

In the given word alphabet positional value are represented.

'FINGER' is written as '69147518'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c597a65d9220d2bf36d3831322395ab339c6397500df43bf7017bec28154d706.png] 

and

'DOG' is written '4157'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3f0b3bc9fba7a6d82a63191b8efcd902644e3e11d61c5df14d540ed39475699.png] 

Similarly,

'FOREST' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d88e13f763c7ce7d6302655865f075bd291cfcc2c94e4f025b7309c33136756c.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"6151851920".**
